args.title: checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks following the latest production deploy of v2.3.1. Remediation: rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production, in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rollback completed and verified; all regions now running v2.3.0. Root cause of the v2.3.1 health check failures still under investigation.

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Reviewed deployment history**: The latest deploy, **v2.3.1**, was unhealthy in production; the most recent previously healthy release was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rolled back checkout-api to v2.3.0** in all production regions — us-east, us-west, and eu-west. Rollback completed and verified.
3. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** describing the health check failures and the rollback remediation; the on-call engineer has been paged.

Root cause of the v2.3.1 failures remains under investigation.

transcript.content: I'll first check the deployment history to identify the most recent healthy release.
transcript.reasoning_content: Need to check deployment history to find the most recent healthy release, then roll back. First list deployments.

transcript.content: The most recent healthy production release is **v2.3.0** (the latest deploy v2.3.1 is unhealthy). I'll roll back to v2.3.0 in all regions.
transcript.reasoning_content: Most recent healthy production release: v2.3.0. Roll back to it, then create incident. The rollback and incident: incident should describe what I did, so it depends on rollback completing? Not strictly dependent—could do both. But incident describes actions; I can call rollback first, then create incident after to confirm success. They're arguably independent, but safer to sequence. Actually the incident says "describing what you did" — I can write it based on intent. But to be accurate about outcome, wait for rollback. I'll do rollback first.

transcript.content: Rollback verified in all regions. Now opening the SEV2 incident.
transcript.reasoning_content: Rollback done in all regions. Now open a SEV2 incident.
